hero.title: Your clear path through the care maze
hero.text: Estimate your care level, prepare applications, file an appeal – {avatarName} guides you step by step. Anonymous, free of charge and without bureaucratic jargon.

promise.text: From the first question to a well-founded estimate in under {timePortal} – instead of weeks of paperwork.

features.heading: What we offer
features.subheading: Everything in one place to support you as well as possible.

rechner.title: Care level calculator
rechner.description: Work out your likely care level without obligation.

widerspruch.title: Appeal assistant
widerspruch.description: Draft legally sound appeals if your application is rejected.

avatar.title: Avatar guidance with “Navi”
avatar.description: Clarify complex questions in an accessible dialogue — by text or gentle audio output.

tagebuch.title: Digital care diary
tagebuch.description: Record care times and relief measures as complete primary evidence for the Medical Service assessment.

qr.title: Encrypted QR system
qr.description: Share your case file securely with relatives or doctors — without disclosing any names.

multi.title: Integrated multi-calculators
multi.description: Degree of disability under VersMedV, victim compensation under SGB XIV and the 2026 tax allowances.

b2b.title: For care staff, advisors and care services
b2b.text: Use advanced case handling, PflegeGPT interfaces and workload analyses.

trust.basis: 4.9 million verified case histories as the mathematical basis for our calculations.
trust.anonym: 100% anonymous: no real names or sensitive data are ever required.
trust.rechtssicher: Legally current for 2026: all allowances, SGB rates and deadlines are kept up to date.
